name: Fruit Dip
description: A simple and flavorful cream cheese dip infused with orange juice and marshmallow creme, ideal for fresh fruit.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients in a dish and beat until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with fresh cut-up fruit.

keywords: fruit dip, orange cream cheese, marshmallow dip

_similar.name: Fluffy Fruit Dip
_similar.description: A light and airy fruit dip made with softened cream cheese, marshmallow creme, and vanilla extract.

recipeInstructions.text: In a bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, marshmallow creme, and vanilla extract.
Mix until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with your choice of fresh fruit.

_similar.keywords: fluffy fruit dip, marshmallow dip, sweet appetizer

_similar.name: Hot Cheese Dip
_similar.description: A creamy bacon and cheddar dip baked inside a pumpernickel bread shell.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the pumpernickel loaf and hollow it out, leaving a thick shell.
Mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, and bacon bits until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the hollowed-out bread.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil, leaving the hole with the cheese mixture uncovered.
Bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.
Serve hot with the bread pieces.

_similar.keywords: pumpernickel dip, hot bacon dip, cheddar dip

_similar.name: Orange-Pineapple Jello
_similar.description: A fruity Jello dessert with orange, pineapple, and nuts.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup frozen orange juice concentrate

recipeInstructions.text: Drain pineapple and reserve syrup. Add water to make ¾ cup.
Heat the liquid to boiling.
Place Jello in a bowl and add hot liquid, pineapple, and orange juice concentrate.
Chill until thickish.
Fold in Dream Whip along with marshmallows and pecans.

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese
